tracedBy: Claude (direct, no worker); about 8 minutes wall time
question: Does any non-ammo attachment on any multiplayer weapon select a damage, penetration, fire-rate or muzzle-velocity effect that the Analyzer does not model? (Catalog-wide form of L68.)
method: List the effect families under Common/Hardware/Weapons/_WeaponModifiers; pick HeadShotDamage (2), Penetration (3), Firerate (1) and MuzzleVelocity (4).
For each WME_* asset in those folders, grep the whole Common XML tree for references by route, excluding the WME's own folder.

Grep all Hardware/Weapons XML for inline Class_b1afeb65 (projectile replacement, Field_808dd66c) and Class_e85fff64 (protection index, Field_fbfacac9) outside _Ammo; for each object, find the Class_897c99a7 parts that reference it and their Field_819acc98 selector GUIDs.
Compare the non-ammo hits with data/attachments.json and the 7 September menu audit.

knownAnswerControl.check: Barrel muzzle-velocity effects against site BARRELS velMult

sharedDamageEffects.WME_Protection_P10: selected only by _Ammo WPMs (JHP, subsonic JHP, shotgun slugs)
sharedDamageEffects.WME_Penetration_P05/P10/P15: selected only by _Ammo WPMs (FMJ, Match, PolymerCase, Flechette, Tungsten)

inlineWeaponBodyOverrides.result: Every inline projectile replacement targets a PD_SP_* bullet (or PD_.300BLK_Carbine_SP_PS_Silenced). Selectors pair consistently with bullet owner names: 7672760d-2f20-455c-a08b-32f76a8484a1 -> PD_SP_Player (14 parts; also used by VB_VEH_Car_Flyer60_SP), 6d45cd64-1cce-4736-8d81-b2b8a03eef5a -> PD_SP_Enemy (11), e67ab0f5-fb2e-40b6-8e8b-689bc69bbeaf -> PD_SP_Squad (7). The six inline protection-index objects (value 3; M39EMR 4) all sit on 7672760d parts (ACE32, G36, M4A1, XM7, M39EMR, M18). Classified as single-player owner overrides, out of scope.
inlineWeaponBodyOverrides.anomaly: M39EMR part ...003d on selector 7672760d targets PD_SP_Squad_762x51mmNATO_Semi rather than a PD_SP_Player bullet; single-player only, not investigated.

p90HeavyRecoilSpring.uniqueness: The only U_PRG_*Base* progression in any *_Ability.xml.
p90HeavyRecoilSpring.noAttachmentAsset: None of the three Attachment_P90_ERG_* files (Ergonomic, Improved_Mag_Catch, RecoilBuffer) references this progression; no English string contains 'recoil spring'.
p90HeavyRecoilSpring.buildHistory: P90_Ability is not in the 1.4.3.0 xml-added or xml-changed sets, so the branch predates 1.4.3.0. The 13 September note (docs/archive/FROSTY_STAT_DISCOVERY_2026-09-13.md) that it had no ability branch is corrected here.
p90HeavyRecoilSpring.menuEvidence: 7 September audit: USG-90 Ergonomics None, Improved Mag Catch and Aftermarket Buffer all show 900 RPM; no spring choice is captured.
p90HeavyRecoilSpring.conclusion: Present in source as an ability branch without an attachment asset or menu entry; not a default (menu shows 900). Keep site usg90 rpm 899.999 and ergo avail [mag_catch, buffer].

siteImpact: None. No non-ammo attachment selects an unmodeled damage, penetration, fire-rate or velocity effect in multiplayer.
